node.html: As Offensive Security Director at Abissi, I define the strategic direction of the offensive security practice, aligning client priorities with business objectives, threat exposure, and evolving regulatory expectations. I own executive client relationships and provide senior accountability across the consulting portfolio, driving service positioning, prioritization, and governance to strengthen client impact and support the growth of the business unit.

Member of CEN/CENELEC JTC13/WG9, supported by Cyberstand, contributing to the development of horizontal standards that supports the implementation of the EU Cyber Resilience Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/2847).

Developed and delivered course modules for the “Secure Coding for Embedded Systems” program, covering system hardening, secure update mechanisms, TLS, and supply chain risk management. Focused on equipping engineers with practical, design-level security strategies for building resilient embedded systems.

Led application security initiatives across web platforms and IoT environments, helping organizations adopt secure-by-design practices throughout the SDLC. Defined security requirements, threat modeling approaches, and engineering enablement initiatives that helped clients integrate security earlier in product and development decisions, while training security champions to scale adoption internally. Managed cross-functional security projects from scoping through delivery, acting as a bridge between engineering leadership, product stakeholders, and security strategy.

Performed penetration testing, secure code reviews, and vulnerability assessments across software, hardware, and cloud environments. Advised clients on improving their security posture and delivered workshops to help development teams integrate security into everyday engineering workflows.

Contributor to the Mobile Security Testing Guide (MSTG) and Web Security Testing Guide (WSTG), collaborating with global experts to keep content aligned with evolving threat landscapes. Translated key OWASP resources into Italian, including OWASP Top 10 (2021), ASVS, LLM AI Cybersecurity & Governance Checklist, and OWASP LLM Top 10, expanding access to security knowledge within the Italian-speaking community.

Delivered advanced technical training on Java Enterprise Edition (Java EE), covering Servlets, JSP, RESTful APIs, and Spring Boot. Emphasized secure coding practices and application-layer defense strategies.
Designed and maintained core platform components using Scala, Lift Framework, JavaScript, and MongoDB, with a strong focus on scalability, performance, and long-term maintainability.
Contributed to backend reliability and architectural improvements by evolving a microservices-based platform built with Scala, Akka, and Lagom.
Developed backend and frontend systems for web and mobile applications using Node.js and React, while mentoring junior developers and promoting clean code and collaborative engineering practices.

Design and develop full-stack software solutions with an emphasis on scalability, security, testability, and maintainability. Provide strategic consulting on architecture decisions, technology stacks, and engineering best practices, supporting teams in building robust and future-proof systems.
